mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopion.tPrfDeptStore WHERE DeptId = #{deptId} AND StoreCode = #{storeCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfDeptStore (DeptId, StoreCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate) VALUES (#{deptId}, #{storeCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tPrfDeptStore SET State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE DeptId = #{deptId} AND StoreCode = #{storeCode}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopion.tPrfDeptStore WHERE DeptId = #{deptId} AND StoreCode = #{storeCode}
